training_data.name: breast-cancer
training_data.title: Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer
training_data.source: scikit-learn bundled copy of the UCI WDBC dataset (sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer)
training_data.description: 569 fine-needle-aspirate records, 30 highly correlated numeric features.
training_data.sensitive_use: not applicable: no sensitive attribute is recorded
limitations: 569 rows only; test sets are small and intervals are wide.

splits.method: stratified on the label; one fixed seed

explanations.target: raw model log-odds of the positive class

limitations: 569 rows only; test sets are small and intervals are wide.

ethical_considerations: Subgroup gaps measured here describe this dataset and this model, not causes.
The sensitive attribute is used for auditing only and is not a model input; proxies may remain.
